steps.name: review-project-state
steps.description: Aggregate and present project state to researcher; reassess priorities given t0086's robustness + clustering + biological-plausibility results (6 Genuine + 7 Marginal + 7 Stochastic; both clusters exotic on NMDA + NaP).

steps.description: Three-round discussion: t0088 (re-cluster 13 Genuine + Marginal cells from t0086 and per-cluster Vm-trace deep-dive at 16 directions, extension of S-0086-03); suggestion cleanup (1 rejection); confirmation.

steps.name: finalize
